title: lichen-oscore provisioning.rs is orphaned dead code holding secret-bearing types
description: rust/lichen-oscore/src/provisioning.rs declares BRProvisioningSession/NodeProvisioningSession (both hold secret key material, both have manual Drop->wipe()) but no 'mod provisioning;' exists in lib.rs, so the module never compiles. Silently dead today. Decide re-wire vs delete; if re-wired, add Zeroize/ZeroizeOnDrop impls + compile-time assertions consistent with zeroize_asserts.rs, and note it uses aes/ccm/hkdf which would need direct deps.
